text:
nina: quick sync — customer Alpha wants explicit token counts + trace ID in every response. their SDK parses usage.prompt_tokens/completion_tokens today. Do we standardize on that or use our own naming?

liam: leaning toward matching OpenAI usage.* fields for hosted API to reduce friction. +1 for prompt_tokens/completion_tokens/total_tokens.

omar: warning: our internal billing uses token_estimate and cost_units. If we expose both names we risk confusion. Suggest mapping internal -> public but keep internal name in telemetry only.

maya: ops ask: we need a single top-level trace id for log correlation (trace_id). Nested trace in metadata is ok but hard for quick lookups.

jess: launch criteria checklist idea: (1) field names decided and documented, (2) SDKs return stable aliases, (3) telemetry emits internal->public mapping, (4) privacy sign-off on no sensitive leakage. Can we hit that for hosted beta?

kevin: engineering constraints: emitting both token_usage and usage payload increases response size. We can emit a compact 'usage' object: {prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens} and also set response.headers['x-trace-id']. But headers won't work for all clients (websocket/stream).

liam: for streaming/chat we must stream the same usage summary at end-of-stream. Also agree on a top-level string 'trace_id' in JSON body for easy parsing.

nina: product tradeoff: customers who asked are priority because their billing relies on per-token fields. Recommend P0 for hosted, P1 for dedicated/private (due to deployment schedules).

omar: embeddings/rerank endpoints: they asked for per-item token counts and embedding_ids. Propose 'usage.input_tokens' for batch inputs and 'items': [{embedding_id, input_tokens}]. Need to decide shape so eval runs can consume easily.

maya: ops: per-item arrays are OK but we must cap size for large batches. Also include model_version and model_commit metadata for reproducibility.

jess: scope negotiation: do we bundle aliases (usage vs token_usage) in phase 1 or ship single naming with a 3-month deprecation alias? Shipping aliases reduces immediate customer pain.

kevin: implementation plan: emit 'usage' + 'trace_id' top-level. Add header 'x-rw-trace' for infra. Alias layer in SDKs for 'token_usage' -> 'usage'. Backfill docs and create migration guide.

nina: decision todo: finalize exact keys (usage.prompt_tokens, usage.completion_tokens, usage.total_tokens, trace_id, model_version, items[].embedding_id). Need sign-off from privacy and infra by EOD Friday.

deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: RFC created: https://go/redwood/rfc/api-fidelity-987 — please add comments.

liam: acked. I'll draft the API spec PR with examples for chat, completions, embeddings and streaming.

omar: will prep telemetry mapping doc and cost reconciliation plan.

maya: ops will run perf estimate for the extra bytes and confirm no latency hit.

jess: i'll prep messaging for customers and update the launch criteria doc.

nina: thanks — next touchpoint: spec PR review on Tues. Short follow-ups only in this thread.
